sloka: कृतं त्वया कर्म महत् सुभीमं हतप्रवीरश्च कृतस्त्वया ऽहम् ।तस्मात् परिश्रान्त इव व्यवस्य न त्वां शरैर्मृत्युवशं नयामि ।। ६.५९.१४३ ।।।।
transliteration: kṛtaṁ tvayā karma mahat subhīmaṁ hatapravīraśca kṛtastvayā 'ham ।tasmāt pariśrānta iva vyavasya na tvāṁ śarairmṛtyuvaśaṁ nayāmi ।। 6.59.143 ।।।।

translations.english: A great task of killing mighty heroes has been accomplished by you. Therefore, you are exhausted. I declare that I will not send you to death.
